says: In a bound repository with a committed instructions source (selected) and a knowledge source (not yet checked), the host launcher offers a qualified start route and an unqualified personal decision route. The person's script starts at 80x24, resizes to 100x30, 80x24, 132x43 and back to 80x24 (the sizes gates/workenv/fixtures/text/terminal.json names), then presses Enter on the focused instructions position and Esc (surface.drive). At every size the trace must keep the selected target, the material qualification element, the blocker with its reason and remedy, and the start action `shown: whole`, with the two positions' labels distinct and focus and selection unchanged by the resize. Enter replaces the body with that position's detail (view w02, target the instructions position, return_view w01) and Esc returns to w01 with the same focus and selection. Negative: no frame dispatches a request or calls an owner operation, the start action is never `executing`, and no element that carries state is `clipped` or `off_screen` at 80x24 — a resize runs nothing and hides nothing.

set.value: The host session read the prepared material it was handed.
